memoryBuilder.verseText: Samuel said: 'Speak, Lord. Your servant is listening.'

sequence.prompt: What happened the night God called Samuel? Put it in order.

items.label: Hannah gave Samuel back to God
A voice called Samuel's name at night
Samuel ran to Eli three times

matches.prompt: Match each one to what they did.

pairs.right: Prayed for Samuel, then gave him to God
Helped Samuel know it was God calling

application.question: God speaks to us in the Bible. What makes listening hard for you?
application.followUp: Samuel needed Eli's help to know it was God — needing help to hear God is normal. And Samuel's listening led to a hard job he did anyway. That is what listening looks like.
